title: Parking Billing Standard: Anniversary Billing Periods and First-Period Rent under the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Standard.** Rent under the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement is billed on the anniversary basis from the start date, with the same month-end fallback as storage units. A billing period starts on the start day of each month, or on the month's last day when that day does not exist in the month, and ends the day before the next period starts. The start date is the first rent due date, and each period's rent is posted on its due date, the first day of the period. Due dates follow the anniversary basis of the class. When the agreement starts, the one-time administrative fee of the space class is also posted.

**First and later periods.** The first period is charged at start, reduced by the move-in discount or the military discount, whichever is greater; the military discount enters that comparison only where it is applied to the agreement. Later periods are reduced by the military discount only where it is applied, and are otherwise charged at the contracted monthly rent. Each reduced amount is the monthly rent less the discount share of it, rounded to the cent.

**When rent is charged.** Rent is charged only while the agreement stands active, delinquent, under a notice of intent to tow, under a compliance termination notice, or moving out. Each billing period is charged once. A period starting on or after the planned vacate date of an agreement that is moving out, or after the termination date of an agreement under a compliance termination notice, is not charged.

### Period boundaries (hypothetical start dates)

| Start day | A period in a month that has that day | A period in a month that lacks it |
|---|---|---|
| 12th | 12 April to 11 May | — |
| 31st | 31 January to the day before the February period | February period starts on February's last day and ends 30 March; the March period starts 31 March |

### Worked figures (hypothetical rents; discount figures from the schedule of each class)

| Case | First period | Later periods |
|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft), $180.00, military discount applied (25% move-in against 10% military) | 25% applies: $135.00 | 10% applies: $162.00 |
| Same space, military discount not applied | 25% applies: $135.00 | $180.00 |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage, $310.00, military discount applied (0% move-in against 10% military) | 10% applies: $279.00 | $279.00 |
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space, $95.00, military discount not applied (50% move-in) | 50% applies: $47.50 | $95.00 |

Boundary of the vacate rule (hypothetical): for a moving-out agreement with a planned vacate date of 12 June and periods starting on the 12th, the period starting 12 June is not charged and the period starting 12 May is owed. For an agreement under a compliance termination notice with a termination date of 12 June, a period starting on 12 June is charged and one starting after it is not.
